response.sql: WITH filtered AS (SELECT driverId, points, wins FROM driverStandings WHERE points > 1.0), per_driver AS (SELECT driverId, AVG(points) AS avg_points, AVG(wins) AS avg_wins FROM filtered GROUP BY driverId), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS mean_avg_wins FROM per_driver) SELECT p.driverId, p.avg_points, p.avg_wins, p.avg_wins - o.mean_avg_wins AS wins_diff FROM per_driver p CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE o.mean_avg_wins IS NOT NULL ORDER BY wins_diff IS NULL, wins_diff DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: Averages use every driverStandings row with points > 1.0 across all seasons and races, with no season filter. AVG skips NULL wins, and the points filter already excludes NULL points.
A driver whose average wins is NULL keeps a NULL difference, sorts last, and is left out of the overall mean. If the overall mean is NULL, the query returns no rows.
Ties in wins_diff at the 10th position are broken arbitrarily, because the request does not specify a tie-breaker.
